name: RMD Remote Gaming & Desktop v1.1.0 (Build #11033)
changelog: Toi uu hoa triet de co che FEC va giam thieu so goi tai tao: Tu dong tat goi du thua khi ket noi LAN sach (loss = 0%), tiet kiem 25-50% bang thong va CPU
Nang cap bo giai ma RUDP Decoder: Chi ghi nhan goi tai tao thuc su khi bi rot that, loai bo dem ao do goi UDP den lech microsecond (Jitter)
